name: Sesshoku Sennou Club
source:
Magaki Souji is a man coming from a family whose members have various special abilities.
His special power allow him to mind control people when having physical contact with them.
He uses it to live without working and playing with girls.
This time he especially set his eyes on 2 girls targets.
